note: One row per component in the UI SDK Component Behavior Inventory (Notion, 55 pages). `id` is the canonical name an agent uses and matches shadcn/ui's PascalCase export where one exists. `inventory` is the page title in the Notion inventory. `shadcn` is the file name under shadcn/ui's radix base, or null when shadcn ships nothing for it. `registry` is the Vois registry item that already themes it, or null. Checked against shadcn-ui/ui at commit 055aa6b (2026-11-23) and registry/registry.json (52 items). `card` names the component's behavior card (behaviors/<card>.json) where one exists.

statuses.have: A vois-* registry item already exists.
statuses.covered: No item of its own: another vois-* item does the job. `coveredBy` names it.
statuses.build: shadcn ships it and the registry has no item yet. Pull the shadcn source and theme it with Vois tokens.
statuses.compose: shadcn ships no single component. Build it from other registry items once those exist. `composedFrom` names them.
statuses.defer: shadcn ships nothing and the pattern is real. Write the behavior card now, build the component later.
statuses.skip: Not a UI control for this registry, or no shadcn source and no use in the skills. Behaviors stay in Notion.

names.note: Added in registry 0.27.0. JOB-CONFIRM-DESTRUCTIVE picks it.
A Combobox where the typed text is the value.
Added in registry 0.28.0.
Built on Embla. Arrow keys skip a text field. The end button is aria-disabled so it keeps focus. Pass aria-label on the root and on each slide.
SwatchPicker (vois-swatch-picker) covers a fixed set only, not a free color picker.

The same recipe as DatePicker: a text Input that accepts a typed date, plus a calendar button that opens a Popover with the Calendar. Typing and picking write one value. The value rules are the `date` field type in vois-fields. A date range uses the same recipe, as a range variant. Rules: JOB-ACCEPT-TEXT.
Built on Vaul. Focus moves in on open (Vaul leaves it off). The close button is the alternative to dragging. Slide motion is on --motion-duration-slow.
Upload is listed as not covered in vois-fields.
FieldLabel wraps the Radix Label.
Select and Command cover the listbox jobs. Fold the Listbox behaviors into their cards.
Added in registry 0.28.0.
A bounded gauge, not Progress. Read the Notion page before deciding.
Added in registry 0.28.0.
vois-fields owns the value rules (money, percent).
Built on the input-otp library. Takes a pasted whole code and strips spaces and dashes (vois-fields FIELD-PASTE). Label, status icon and Resend are composed with vois-field and vois-button.
Added in registry 0.28.0.
InputGroup already has the show-password button.
A styling wrapper, not a control. The inventory says it has no interaction behavior.
Radix Progress. Clamps the value; the caller names it.
Built on react-resizable-panels 4 (Group, Panel, Separator). A number is pixels, so write percentages as strings. Not PanelLayout, which places one side panel.
Built on shadcn's ToggleGroup, fixed to one choice. Exports SegmentedControl and SegmentedControlItem only. ToggleGroup is vois-toggle-group's name.
vois-patterns marketing rules say no dividers. The component still exists for lists and menus.
Dated events in order: a feed, changelog or order progress. Not the same as Stepper, which gates a flow.
Added in registry 0.28.0. The skills say Sonner. Use Toast as the id. vois-toast is built on Radix Toast, not Sonner.
The item is the group (ToggleGroup, from the Figma Toggle Group Button set). A single Toggle, one pressed button on its own, has no item yet.
A pill that toggles on and off, laid out as a wrapping row. Not the joined bar of vois-toggle-group, which is for a few formatting or view options. Rules: JOB-CHOOSE-FROM-LIST.

A slim bar above the header with a bold highlight, one short sentence, an action and an optional dismiss control. Variants in the Figma source (Personify Design System file, Banner): Layout is Sticky (full width, pinned to the top) or Floating (rounded, inset). Style is Accent (light) or Aux (dark). The action is a labelled button or an arrow icon. The dismiss control is shown for a promotion and left out for an outage or account issue, which stays until resolved. Not the Alert Banner that righter writes copy for. Rules: JOB-TRANSIENT-FEEDBACK.

One track with two thumbs, one at each end, that move along discrete steps, for a minimum and a maximum. The single-value Slider is vois-slider. Rules: JOB-CHOOSE-FROM-LIST. The Figma source is pending.
Radix has a Toolbar primitive. shadcn ships no wrapper.
Suggests text after a trigger character such as @, / or #, at the caret. Not a menu opened by a button.
Page not read yet. Confirm before keeping skip.

ruleScopes.note: vois-tokens rule categories that apply to particular components. vois-components/scripts/retrieval.mjs puts these rules in those components' packets. Every other category is cross-cutting and stays out of packets. Components may come from names or outsideInventory.

outsideInventory.note: Names the vois-components Quick Reference uses that have a shadcn source and no registry item. They are not in the Notion inventory, so they get no behavior card yet. Listed so the gap is visible. Spinner, Stepper, Wizard, Badge, AvatarGroup, List, Form, Panel, RichTextEditor and Card were added because jobs in components-rules.json name them as answers, so `query.mjs <name>` can find them. Their `shadcn` and `registry` fields were checked on 2026-11-25 against shadcn-ui/ui at 055aa6b and `registry/registry.json`. A null `shadcn` means shadcn ships no file of that name (Stepper, Wizard, List, Panel, RichTextEditor, PollResults). AvatarGroup is null too, but shadcn does export it, from its `avatar` file, which is Avatar's name here. Some of these have a registry item, so the first sentence of this note does not describe them.
